text:
liam: heads up — our blackbox streaming checks for embeddings in ap-southeast1 started failing intermittently around 03:12 UTC, looks networky not GPU. sre-bot posted a flurry of 503s.
elaine: saw that alert. are failures across all nodes or a subset?
liam: mostly on zone ap-southeast1-b, 12/48 probes failed over a 5m window. probe logs show TLS handshake timeouts and a handful of 'connection reset by peer'.
maria: copying logs: ``[blackbox] probe=stream-embeddings target=embed-prod-apse-b error="TLS handshake timeout"``
liam: hypothesis: noisy VM host or SNAT port exhaustion in that AZ. also noticed increased retransmits in perf counters.
tony: can we reproduce with a controlled packet-loss/latency injection in the canary pool? want to confirm probe sensitivity before tuning alerts.
liam: yes — proposing to run a short chaos job that injects 1%, 3%, 5% packet loss and 50ms extra latency for 10m on a small subset.
elaine: +1. Also, we should decouple probe noise from SLO alerts. Current alert fires on 5m failure ratio > 2% which is too twitchy when we have brief infra blips.
liam: suggested changes:
```yaml
# blackbox probe alert (candidate)
expr: sum by(region) (rate(blackbox_probe_failed_total{module="stream-embeddings"}[5m]))
 / sum by(region) (rate(blackbox_probe_total{module="stream-embeddings"}[5m])) > 0.04
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: p2
annotations:
  summary: "stream-embeddings probe failure ratio > 4% (10m)"
```
liam: moves from a 2% 5m -> 4% 10m and raise for 10m to reduce noise.
maria: I like 10m, but we should add a secondary alert for sustained capacity degradation hitting actual replicas' success rate (from application metrics) to avoid masking real issues.
elaine: agree. add cross-check with app-level p50/p95 latencies and per-replica success rate. if both probe and app metrics degrade -> page p1.
tony: for the chaos run, what probe config do we use? we should capture handshake RTT, connect failures, and stream delta.
liam: current probe module config (short):
```json
{
  "module": "stream-embeddings",
  "timeout": "15s",
  "tcp_connect": true,
  "tls": true,
  "headers": {"x-rw-probe": "1"}
}
```
liam: I'll spin the chaos job against canary nodes at 03:45 UTC for 15m (1%->5% step). devex-bot please increase probe sampling in canary region during the run.
devex-bot: noted — bumping blackbox probe sampling to 10s for canary targets for the next 30m. will post histogram exports to /dashboards/canary-fidelity.
sre-bot: automated alert: blackbox-stream-apse-b spike detected at 03:12 UTC, 12 failures in 5m. ticket created #INC-4521.
ops-rotation: I'm on standby for paging during the run. prefer to have a rollback plan if we see >10% app errors.
liam: rollback plan: revert chaos iptables rules and drain affected nodes; but we won't touch dedicated capacity. also we'll pin traffic to other zones if cross-zone failover healthy.
maria: after the run, we should update the SLO noise budget doc with the probe fidelity matrix: map probe sensitivity to real user-impact probability. current doc under /docs/sre/noise-budget needs a short section for streaming probes.
elaine: +1. also update grafana: create a 'probe-fidelity' panel showing probe failure ratio vs app success ratio with correlation scatter for past 72h.
liam: quick prometheus query to show correlation:
```
probe_fail_ratio = (sum(rate(blackbox_probe_failed_total{module="stream-embeddings"}[5m]))
 / sum(rate(blackbox_probe_total{module="stream-embeddings"}[5m])))
app_err_rate = sum(rate(api_request_errors_total{route=~"/embed.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(api_request_total{route=~"/embed.*"}[5m]))
```
liam: we'll overlay those in the panel and add an alert if both > 1% for 15m.
tony: will capture tcpdump + pcap off one affected node during injection and upload to s3://rw-debug/probes/apse-b/1812349999.pcap
maria: after this, we should consider adding a lightweight TCP connect-only probe as a low-noise early-warning signal alongside the full streaming check.
elaine: agreed. that can be lower cost and lower false-positive but won't catch app-level protocol issues.
liam: timeline: chaos run at 03:45, sampling increased until 04:15, collect logs and pcaps, meeting at 04:30 in #eng-sre to review. tagging @ops-rotation @devex-bot
sre-bot: acknowledged — incident INC-4521 updated with run notes and links to dashboards.
liam: thanks all. I'll post the after-action summary and recommended alert delta in this thread. :thumbsup:
